# HorizontalDumbbellChart

## Overview

Top-level orchestration wrapper for the horizontal dumbbell chart. Composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup`, `ChartFooter`, and `ChartAccessibility` into a complete dumbbell (gap/barbell) visualisation. Each category renders two dots connected by a stem, positioned along a shared D3 linear scale.

All design tokens come from the OneUI brand CSS cascade — no runtime JS token resolver, no `modes` prop. Categorical colors (`var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)`, `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)`) resolve via the DataVis CSS pipeline (`generateDataVisCSS` → `@layer brand`).

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `274:14998`
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=274-14998

## Architecture

```
HorizontalDumbbellChart (node 274:14998)
│   className={styles.container}  — gap via CSS module two-layer token
│   wrapped by ChartAccessibility (chartType="horizontal-bar")
│
├── ChartHeader          (conditional: chartHeader)
├── ChartLegend          (conditional: chartLegend)
├── DataDisplay          (conditional: dataDisplay, id=dataDisplayId)
├── barGroupWrapper      (className={styles.barGroupWrapper}, flex inline)
│   └── HorizontalDumbbellBarGroup
│       ├── HorizontalDumbbellBar[] (role="button", roving tabIndex)
│       ├── ZeroLine     (auto, aria-hidden)
│       ├── XAxis        (conditional: xAxis, aria-hidden)
│       └── HoverBadge   (conditional: hoverBadge, aria-hidden)
└── ChartFooter          (conditional: chartFooter)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { HorizontalDumbbellChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
// or from the local path:
import { HorizontalDumbbellChart } from './HorizontalDumbbellChart';
```

## Data Formats

### Direct Format (DumbbellDataPoint[])

```tsx
const data: DumbbellDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Germany', value1: 1200, value2: 3500 },
  { category: 'France',  value1: 1800, value2: 4200 },
];

<HorizontalDumbbellChart data={data} />
```

### Canonical Format (ChartSeriesDataPoint[]) — Recommended

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Germany', series: '2024', value: 1200 },
  { category: 'Germany', series: '2025', value: 3500 },
  { category: 'France',  series: '2024', value: 1800 },
  { category: 'France',  series: '2025', value: 4200 },
];

<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={data}
  seriesOrder={['2024', '2025']}
/>
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Germany', value1: 1200, value2: 3500 },
    { category: 'France',  value1: 1800, value2: 4200 },
  ]}
  width={440}
  height={400}
/>
```

### Full anatomy

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={canonicalData}
  seriesOrder={['2024', '2025']}
  width={480}
  height={500}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'European Market Range.',
    chartSubtitleValue: '2024 vs 2025 by region.',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{ seriesLabels: ['2024', '2025'] }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a bar.',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—', supportingData: false },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    categoryLabels: true,
    xAxis: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    xAxisConfig: { tickCount: 6 },
    barHeight: 'M',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Finance.',
    annotationRightValue: '*Values in thousands GBP.',
  }}
  accessibility={{ enabled: true, dataTable: true }}
/>
```

### With currency formatting

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={data}
  barGroupConfig={{
    valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
    categoryLabels: true,
    xAxis: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Auto height for sparse data

```tsx
<HorizontalDumbbellChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Before', value1: 1200, value2: 3500 },
    { category: 'After',  value1: 2800, value2: 5100 },
  ]}
  autoHeight
  width={440}
  barGroupConfig={{ categoryLabels: true, xAxis: true }}
/>
```

## Token Pipeline

All design tokens are resolved via CSS at render time — no JS resolver:

```
Convex brand data
  → generateDataVisCSS
  → useStyleInjection
  → @layer brand on :root

Chart reads:
  var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)   ← dot 1 color
  var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)   ← dot 2 color
  var(--Spacing-5)                    ← container gap (via CSS module)
```

## CSS Module

```css
/* Two-layer hook pattern — consumers can override via CSS custom property */
.container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--HorizontalDumbbellChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5));
  box-sizing: border-box;
  position: relative;
}

/* flex set inline — exempt (prop-driven: autoHeight toggles 0 0 auto vs 1) */
.barGroupWrapper {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
```

## Legend Auto-Generation

Priority order (highest first):

1. `chartLegendConfig.items` — manual items
2. `chartLegendConfig.seriesLabels` or `seriesOrder` — 2-item legend with `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1/2)`
3. Auto-detect from canonical `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` unique series
4. Fallback: `"Series 1"` / `"Series 2"`

## DataDisplay in Hover Mode

When `dataDisplayConfig.mode = "hover"`:

| State | `mainLabelValue` | `dataHead.dataLeadValue` | `badgeConfig.value` |
|-------|-----------------|--------------------------|---------------------|
| Idle | `configMainLabelValue` | `configDataHead.dataLeadValue` | `configBadgeConfig.value` |
| Hovered | hovered category name | `"v1 – v2"` (or `formatHoverLeadValue`) | `"X.X%"` diff (or `formatHoverBadgeValue`) |

## Zero Line

A vertical zero line appears automatically when the data domain spans zero. Positioned at x=0 on the D3 scale, aligned with the bars area. No configuration needed.

## Height Behavior

- Fixed height: `height` prop controls total container height; bar group stretches via `flex: 1` to fill the remainder after header/legend/DataDisplay/footer.
- `autoHeight`: container collapses to content height — bar group uses `flex: 0 0 auto`. Eliminates void gap on sparse (1–2 bar) data.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default):

| Layer | Feature |
|-------|---------|
| Chart wrapper | `role="figure"`, auto-summary, hidden `<table>` |
| Live region | `useChartAccessibility` → announces hovered data to screen readers |
| aria-controls | Bars link to `DataDisplay` via `dataDisplayId` |
| Bar group | `useRovingTabIndex` with `orientation: "vertical"` |
| Each bar | `role="button"`, `aria-label`, `data-roving-item` |
| Decorative | ZeroLine, XAxis, HoverBadge all `aria-hidden="true"` |

### Keyboard Navigation

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Tab` | Focus enters first dumbbell |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | Move to next/prev dumbbell (wraps) |
| `Home` / `End` | First / last dumbbell |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Trigger click handler |
| `Tab` (again) | Exit the bar group |
